source: Expanded & verified 2026-06-13 from the full 117-command set + official docs.
note: REFERENCE / inspiration, not triggers. Powerful command combinations and what each is for. Decide whether one fits the user's current task by reasoning about that task, never by matching a stored condition.

steps: /plan describe the change so Claude designs before editing
/branch snapshot the conversation before approving
approve the plan and let Claude implement
/goal set the success condition for the change
/diff review every changed file and per-turn change
/rewind roll code and conversation back if it goes wrong
playbooks.benefit_en: Design first, keep a safety net, review before you trust it.

steps: /context check where the context window is being spent
/rewind pick Summarize from here to compress early setup
/compact summarize with focus instructions at a phase boundary
/btw ask side questions so they never enter history
continue the same task with room to breathe
playbooks.benefit_en: Outlive the context window without losing decisions that matter.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 活过上下文上限，关键决定不丢。

steps: /branch switch into a copy to try approach A yourself
/fork send a background subagent after approach B
keep working in the main thread while the fork runs
/tasks watch what is running in the background
compare both results when the fork returns
playbooks.benefit_en: Compare two approaches at once without betting the session.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 两个方案同时试，主线不押注。

steps: /usage check headroom before the heavy task
/model pick the strongest model for the work
/effort raise reasoning to high or max
/advisor on for a second-opinion model
/clear start clean if context is already crowded
playbooks.benefit_en: Expensive work starts with the right brain and a reviewer.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 贵的活配对的脑子，还有军师盯着。

steps: /diff review the final uncommitted changes
/code-review scan the diff for bugs, add --fix to apply
/recap generate a one-line summary of the session
/export save the conversation for the record
/clear start fresh for the next task
playbooks.benefit_en: Close a task with review, a record, and a clean desk.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 审查、留档、清桌，一气呵成。

steps: /btw ask the quick aside without touching history
press f in the overlay to fork it into a full session
/branch explore the tangent in a separate copy if it grows
/resume return to the original conversation when done
playbooks.benefit_en: Curiosity answered, zero pollution of the main thread.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 好奇心满足，主线一点不脏。

steps: /goal set a finish condition so Claude works across turns
/background detach the session and free your terminal
claude agents monitor the detached session from anywhere
/loop 5m poll a long-running step until it is done
/schedule set up a recurring cloud routine for maintenance
playbooks.benefit_en: Work continues while you step away; you read the results.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 你离开它干活，回来看结果。

steps: /batch describe the codebase-wide change in plain language
review the decomposed plan of 5 to 30 independent units
approve to spawn one background subagent per unit in a worktree
/workflows watch progress, pause, or resume the run
each unit runs its tests and opens its own pull request
playbooks.benefit_en: A hundred-file chore becomes one instruction plus a progress bar.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 百个文件的体力活，一句话加进度条。

steps: /deep-research ask the question; it fans out web searches
let it fetch and cross-check sources adversarially
/workflows watch the run, pause or resume as needed
receive the synthesized, cited report
/export save the report, then /clear before building
playbooks.benefit_en: Decide on cross-checked sources, not one quick search.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 靠多来源交叉核查下判断，不是一次浅搜。

steps: /debug enable debug logging and describe the issue
/branch snapshot before trying fixes so you can compare
let Claude find the root cause, then apply a fix
/effort up or /advisor on if the same fix keeps failing
/run launch the app to see the fix working, not just tests
/rewind discard a dead end and retry cleanly
playbooks.benefit_en: Chase the root cause; change the brain before repeating.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 追根因，反复失败就换脑子，别重复试。

steps: /review read the pull request locally in your session
/code-review ultra run a deep multi-agent cloud review
/code-review --comment post findings as inline PR comments
/code-review --fix apply the findings to your working tree
/autofix-pr let a cloud session keep CI green on its own
playbooks.benefit_en: Take a PR to green without babysitting CI.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 把 PR 推到全绿，不用盯着 CI。

steps: /teleport pull a web session down into this terminal
/remote-control steer this local session from claude.ai
/desktop continue the same session in the desktop app
/rename label the session so it is easy to find again
/resume reopen the conversation by name or ID elsewhere
playbooks.benefit_en: Move one piece of work across web, terminal, and desktop.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 工作在网页、终端、桌面间搬，线索不断。

steps: /diff see exactly what is about to ship
/security-review scan for injection, auth, and data risks
/code-review high run a broad bug review at higher effort
fix the flagged issues, then re-run /security-review
/review the open PR before merging
playbooks.benefit_en: Catch security holes before they reach users, not after.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 漏洞触达用户前抓住，而非事后。

steps: /resume reopen an earlier conversation by name or ID
/context check how much window the restored session uses
/compact summarize with focus instructions if it is heavy
/rewind jump back to the exact checkpoint you left off
/goal restate the finish condition, then continue
playbooks.benefit_en: Pick up exactly where you left off, no re-explaining.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 精确接上断点，不用从头解释。

steps: /init generate a starter CLAUDE.md guide for the repo
/memory refine the project memory with facts that matter
/mcp connect any MCP servers the project needs
/agents set up the subagents Claude can delegate to
/permissions set the allow, ask, and deny rules you want
playbooks.benefit_en: Set up a repo so every later session runs smoother.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 配好仓库，让此后每个会话都更顺。

steps: /fewer-permission-prompts allowlist your safe commands
/goal set the success condition as the finish line
/background detach the session to run on its own
/tasks check in on progress when you return
/usage confirm you have headroom for the run
playbooks.benefit_en: Stop approving popups so a goal-driven run can finish.
playbooks.benefit_zh: 别再点弹窗，让定好目标的任务跑完。
